report_name: Epsom & Ewell Local Cycling & Walking Infrastructure Plan
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) was used to identify indicative current and potential future distribution of cycle trips to work and school, identifying preferred 'fast' and 'quieter' routes to inform the development of the cycle network.
other_tools_developed: Multi-criteria assessment framework (MCAF), Walking Route Audit Tool (WRAT), and Route Selection Tool (RST)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The PCT data was used to identify preferred 'fast' and 'quieter' cycle routes between origin and destination pairs, which informed the development of the aspirational cycle network and the selection of Phase 1 corridors.
pct_usage_quote: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) is an online tool and dataset designed to assist with the strategic planning of cycling networks. It illustrates an indicative current and potential future distribution of cycle trips to work and to school based on different growth scenarios.
total_cost_of_network: Indicative costs vary from approximately £6.8 million to £17.8 million for the cycle corridors and from approximately £15.4 million to £18.5 million for the CWZs.
